rules.text: Never drive toward a wall or building closer than 80 px.
rules.read_back: Whenever the tank drives forward it may only do so if at least 80 pixels of free space lie straight ahead, and whenever it drives backward it may only do so if at least 80 pixels of free space lie straight behind; if it does not drive at all, neither condition is required.

deleted_starters.text: Never fire a shot you can't afford.
Only fire at a robot you saw this turn, with the gun aimed at it.

explanation.headline: Proved: the one rule (S3) holds
explanation.summary: Verus proved S3, which says the robot never drives toward a wall or building closer than 80 px. The code only drives ahead when clearance_ahead is at least 80, and only drives backward when clearance_behind is at least 80. The battle logs list violations of S1 (urban, turn 528) and S2 (both arenas, from turn 0), but those rules were not part of this check, so they say nothing about S3, which was not broken.
